t: What Disease Surveillance Database Is All About
title: What Disease Surveillance Database Is All About
description: Disease surveillance watches illness move: incidence (new cases), prevalence (total cases), mapped by place and time. John Snow's 1854 cholera map traced London's outbreak to the Broad Street pump — epidemiology's founding visualization. Modern systems (WHO, CDC) aggregate lab reports, syndromic signals, and wastewater data; COVID dashboards proved the public value of open surveillance. This database is the complete surveillance record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Disease Surveillance Database: a complete reference database of full surveillance record records.
key_points: What this database holds: full surveillance record records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
Scope: Disease surveillance watches illness move: incidence (new cases), prevalence (total cases), mapped by place and time.
Every record is the full entry — never a stub or description alone.
Teaching ladder: Foundations first, then Compounded, then Advanced.

Move to Compounded when Foundations feel solid.
